name: com.tencent.qcloud.tuikit.tuicallkit.internal.ServiceInitializer
description: Android runs this Tencent Cloud TRTC TUICallKit Provider when the app starts. It registers the call and voice-message recording services and watches screen changes so an active call window can be restored.
disableEffect: The call services will not be registered here, and an active call window cannot be restored through this initializer.
